description: This file defines a React context provider and associated hooks for managing the state of a digital audio workstation (DAW) project, including project data, transport controls, tracks, clips, and integration with an audio engine.

methods.name: useProject()
methods.description: Custom hook to access project context data.

methods.name: ProjectProvider({ children, audio })
methods.description: React component that provides project state and actions to its children components, handling initialization, updates, autosave, and synchronization with the audio engine.

methods.name: addTrack
methods.description: Adds a new track of specified type ('audio' or 'midi') to the project.

methods.name: removeTrack
methods.description: Removes a track from the project given its ID.

methods.name: addClip
methods.description: Adds a clip to a specified track.

methods.name: setBpm
methods.description: Sets the project's beats per minute and updates the audio engine accordingly.

methods.name: togglePlay
methods.description: Toggles the playback state of the transport (play/stop).

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the playback position of the transport and seeks the audio engine.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads project data from a user-provided file.

methods.name: exportAudio
methods.description: Exports the current project audio as a WAV file via offline rendering.

methods.name: saveProject
methods.description: Saves the current project state via the project service.

methods.name: loadProject
methods.description: Loads a project from persistent storage by ID.
